protocol.purpose: Quality comparison; not a performance benchmark
protocol.strict: No reset bypass, position process std 0.03 m/sqrt(s)
protocol.reset: Legacy reset bypass, same position process std 0.03 m/sqrt(s)
protocol.geometry: All three scene-depth, overlap-preference, forward-outline options enabled; recovery settings identical
protocol.inference: Full causal replay from frame zero with UFM, object/environment groups and growing surface; same masks/input hashes
protocol.evaluation: Dataset labels withheld from inference, same baseline initial measured points used in all scores, initialization excluded
protocol.timing_caution: Independent cases/arms overlap on the same 32-core host (three processes at peak). Times are diagnostic, not a controlled speed comparison.
protocol.reset_outputs: First six cases in geometry-matrix-reset, clock/cracker in geometry-matrix-reset-long; duplicate remaining cases in first worker explicitly cancelled.
protocol.rotation_trial: Same strict configuration, rotation process std changed from 2 to 30 degrees/sqrt(s), on clock/tuna/banana/drill/tomato/mustard. All six completed; no defaults changed.

clock.description: Laval supplied object poses; OpenGL camera to RGB-D camera

cautions: Pose-label agreement is not calibrated correctness probability.
Yellow has no independent pose labels.
Cracker starts from a fragmented input gt_mask; baseline evaluation reference has only 10 points. Treat it as an initialization failure case, not evidence of robust recovery.
Seven labelled clips total 844 scored frames, initial frames excluded. Same baseline measured reference points score all variants.
The previous baseline differs in observation filtering, recovery and geometry settings as well as Kalman. Only strict versus reset isolates the bypass.
